$description: Shingō 信号 design tokens (industrial print system). Source of truth for web/shingo.css and ios/Sources/ShingoKit/SGTheme.swift.

color.$note: Two modes, same layering. Dark = bone print on ink stripes with sage plates. Light = ink print on sage stripes with paper plates (never white). Coral is the signal in both.

roles.ground-hi: the print: titles, line art, plates of text

readout.use: timers, counters, hero numbers; thin slanted segments, no ghosts

typeScale.$note: Wordmarks: display 44+ in Big Shoulders; title 26 and inline 15 in Barlow Condensed Bold. No rounded or playful faces.

cuts.$note: 45° chamfers on the top-trailing / bottom-leading axis

geometry.radius: none (radar rings and the device frame only)

rules: Print on the ground: content goes straight onto the stripes; plates are for keys, cards and badges.
One angle: every diagonal is 45° (cuts, hazard stripes, chevrons, stripe field). No rounded corners.
Two tiers: poster screens compose freely; every other screen follows the screen grammar.
Hard type only: industrial signage faces (Big Shoulders, Barlow, IBM Plex Mono). Nothing rounded, bubbly or pixel-cute.
One signal: coral marks one block or one primary action per screen, plus small states.
Every screen ships in both modes. Use role tokens, never raw hex.
Language: English runs the interface. Japanese adds texture once per screen at most. French is the italic aside once per screen at most. All three stacked only once per app.

tiers.utility: masthead → hero → hazard bar → body, printed on the ground
tiers.poster: launch, onboarding, lock screen, empty state: free composition

screenGrammar.masthead: vertical micro-code + title (26) + exactly one tag (vertical Japanese, a hanko, short meta or one action), then a span rule 'value ──── value'
screenGrammar.hero: at most one form: a bar, a number, a plate, a scope or chevrons
screenGrammar.body: print on the ground: rows with ground-3 hairlines, condensed-caps group labels over a print rule, frames for grouped data; plates only for things you press or carry
screenGrammar.coral: one signal block or one primary action, plus small states (unread, active tab, latest entry)
screenGrammar.languages: Japanese in the masthead tag or a seal; French in the span rule (or fine print). One of each at most.

instruments.seg7: seven-segment readout · timers, counters, hero numbers
instruments.ruler: tick-scale slider with a coral needle
instruments.stamp: worn stencil stamp · verified, sealed, void
instruments.ticket: notched, perforated stub · passes, receipts, plans
instruments.keycap: physical push button with LED · the one mechanical action
instruments.dataplate: riveted nameplate with dot-leader specs and matrix code
instruments.marks: crop marks, registration target, palette colour bar
instruments.bootlog: terminal loading lines with coral caret + marching hazard
instruments.blueprint: 24/6 pt grid ground for edit modes
